symptom: The query fails with an argument-count mismatch, or the placeholders come out as ? instead of $1.
cause: A hand-rolled sq.StatementBuilder was used instead of dblib.Psql, so the placeholder format defaults to question marks, which Postgres rejects. Or Columns(...) and Values(...) are different lengths.
steps: Use dblib.Psql as the builder. It is already configured with PlaceholderFormat($) and is the only builder the contract permits.
Count the arguments to Columns and Values — they must match exactly, including the ones added last.
Do not add a column to the INSERT without adding its value; the compiler will not catch it.
Run go_build, then exercise the query through go_test if there is a test for it.
watch_out: rules_lint catches the hand-rolled builder but cannot count your columns. That failure only appears at runtime.
